title: Mohammed A. AlGhamdi (Board Director · CEO · FCIArb · Institution Builder) launches 'Institutions & Individuals' newsletter with a 4-part essay series prompted by Incorruptible
summary: Mohammed A. AlGhamdi — Board Director, CEO, corporate governance expert, Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators (FCIArb), self-described 'Institution Builder' — launches a new LinkedIn newsletter, 'Institutions & Individuals,' whose first essay opens a four-part series prompted directly by Incorruptible. The framing question: 'If corporate purpose is meant to endure, what should protect it?'
blockquote: I'm launching Institutions & Individuals, a new newsletter exploring how institutions shape, and are shaped by, human judgment. The first essay begins a four-part series prompted by Eric Ries's Incorruptible and asks a question of institutional continuity: If corporate purpose is meant to endure, what should protect it?
